# Hy-Vee Health with Oscar Expands Across Iowa, Into Kansas City and Omaha for 2027 Open Enrollment


November 18, 2026 6:03pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_9b39437eda6f4a681198ea69f4eaff17/hioscar/news/2026-11-18_Hy_Vee_Health_with_Oscar_Expands_Across_Iowa_Into__233.pdf)


*Individuals and families can shop for Hy-Vee Health with Oscar on HealthCare.gov starting Nov. 1.*


DES MOINES, Iowa--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Hy-Vee, Inc. ("Hy-Vee"), a leading grocery store in the Midwest, and[Oscar](https://www.hioscar.com/?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-hyvee&utm_medium=iowa_all_null&utm_term=regional) , one of the fastest-growing insurers in the individual market and part of[Oscar Health](http://www.oscarhealth.com/) (NYSE: OSCR), today announced that[Hy-Vee Health with Oscar](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/oscar-hy-vee?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-hyvee&utm_medium=iowa_all_null&utm_term=regional) is expanding statewide across Iowa and launching in Kansas City and Omaha for 2027 Open Enrollment.1


Beginning Nov. 1, 2026, individuals and families can enroll in *Hy-Vee Health with Oscar* directly through[HealthCare.gov](http://healthcare.gov/) for 2027 coverage. Employees in[CHOICE Arrangements](http://www.hioscar.com/for-employers/choice-employers) (formerly ICHRA) can also enroll using their tax-free monthly employer contributions.


Hy-Vee became joint owner of Exemplar Care in 2024, rebranding the direct primary care practice as Hy-Vee Health Exemplar Care and helping the practice expand to more than 17 clinic locations across the Midwest.


The *Hy-Vee Health with Oscar* plan makes getting care as easy as shopping at Hy-Vee. Members get a full suite of healthcare, lifestyle, and shopping benefits in one comprehensive package:


- **Budget-friendly coverage and medications:** Competitive monthly premiums and affordable prescriptions available at Hy-Vee pharmacies for individuals and the whole family.
- **Free care at**[Hy-Vee Health Exemplar Care](https://www.exemplar.care/) 2 **(a $2,600 value for a family of four** 3 **):** $0 primary care, urgent care, and telehealth visits; $0 annual and routine labs; and $0 on 100-plus generic medications.
- **More doctors and hospitals:** Iowa members have exclusive access to University of Iowa Health Care, MercyOne, and UnityPoint health systems. Members in Kansas City have access to HCA Midwest Health, University of Kansas Health System, and AdventHealth System. Omaha members receive access to CHI Health and Nebraska Methodist Health System.
- **One-on-one guidance:** Every member gets access to dedicated Oscar Care Guides and an everyday AI health guide,[Oswell](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/meet-oswell?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-hyvee&utm_medium=iowa_all_null&utm_term=regiona) 4, to help members find care, understand benefits, and receive personalized guidance.
- **Everyday rewards:** $50 in Hy-Vee rewards redeemable on groceries, gas, dietitian services, and more.


" *Hy-Vee Health with Oscar* makes offering competitive benefits easy and affordable for businesses of all sizes,” explained Geoff Bartsh, Senior Vice President of Markets for Oscar Insurance. “As we grow across the Midwest, we’re excited to make healthcare simple, accessible, and affordable for more communities, paired with everyday savings from Hy-Vee.”


“We are proud to expand our partnership with Oscar to bring affordable, high-quality care to more Midwest families through the providers, pharmacies, and stores they know and trust,” said Dr. Jon Van Der Veer, Founder and CEO of Hy-Vee Health Exemplar Care.


Employers can enroll their teams at[hioscar.com/for-employers](https://www.hioscar.com/for-employers?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-hyvee&utm_medium=iowa_all_null&utm_term=regional) , or through their broker. Individuals, families, and employees can sign up through Jan, 15, 2027:


- **Iowa:** Visit[HealthCare.gov](http://healthcare.gov/) , call 1-833-419-8482, or connect with an insurance agent. Employees receiving tax-free contributions from work, should check with their employers for details.
- **Johnson County, Kansas, and Jackson County, Missouri (Kansas City metro):** Visit[hioscar.com/get-coverage](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-hyvee&utm_medium=iowa_all_null&utm_term=kc) or connect with an insurance agent.
- **Douglas County, Nebraska (Omaha metro):** Visit[hioscar.com/get-coverage](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage?utm_source=businesswire_press-release&utm_campaign=all_null_oe-27-hyvee&utm_medium=iowa_all_null&utm_term=omaha) or connect with an insurance agent.


**About Oscar Insurance** Oscar Insurance is one of the largest and fastest-growing health insurers dedicated to the individual market. Oscar serves millions of individuals across the country with innovative products and CHOICE Arrangement solutions (formerly ICHRA) tailored to their life stages, health needs, and budgets. Oscar technology-powered experiences make high-quality care easy to use and feel personal. Oscar is part of Oscar Health, Inc. (NYSE: OSCR). Learn more at[HiOscar.com](http://hioscar.com/) .


**About Hy-Vee Health Exemplar Care** Hy-Vee Health Exemplar Care is a membership-based healthcare organization addressing the evolving needs of today’s patients through accessible, transparent, and relationship-driven care. Operating clinics across five Midwest states, Hy-Vee Health Exemplar Care offers healthcare through flexible membership options designed to meet patients where they are in their health journey. The organization is focused on strengthening patient-provider relationships and delivering a more trusted, sustainable healthcare experience.
